notes: Initial N-14 (filed 2021-02-19) of Matthews International Funds: combined prospectus/information statement for the open-end reorganisation of Matthews Emerging Asia Fund into Matthews Asia Small Companies Fund, both series of the same trust ('an open-end management investment company'). No shareholder vote ('NO SHAREHOLDER ACTION IS REQUIRED', Rule 17a-8), so meeting_date is null and shareholder_approval is not a condition. Acquirer named as Matthews Asia Small Companies Fund; the filing says it is to be renamed, inconsistently: 'Matthews Emerging Markets Small Companies Fund' (letter, Q&A, cover body) vs 'Matthews Emerging Markets Small Cap Fund' (cover heading) and 'Matthew Emerging Markets Small Cap Fund' (SAI). Exchange at aggregate NAV; the 'specified exchange ratio' is determined by the funds' NAVs, not fixed, so exchange_ratio is null. No tickers printed. security_class: shares of beneficial interest (Institutional and Investor Class) of an open-end fund; recorded as common, uncertain. The Agreement and Plan of Reorganization is '[To come]' in this draft, so no outside/termination date; the summary says only that it may be terminated by mutual consent. The record date in the letter is a placeholder '[●], 2021'. Conditions come from the summary list ('Unless waived...'); ric_or_tax_status from the required final dividend; 'other' covers reps/warranties and covenants.
